title: “Read me the code to cancel it”
scenario: A caller says someone is resetting your email password. A six-digit code arrives, and the caller asks you to read it aloud so they can cancel the reset.

answers.A: Change the password and review active sessions before contacting support.
answers.B: Share the code because the caller is using it to cancel, not approve, the reset.
answers.C: Do not share the code; end the call and secure the email account from the official app/site.

explanation: The same code can often complete the reset the caller claims to be stopping.
proTip: Never let an incoming caller narrate what your security code “means.”
